mathematics.quantifiers: Every finite field F, prime characteristic p, actual MulChar F Complex of exact order seven and every p residue class 1 through 6 modulo seven. The source consumer additionally has an actual primitive AddChar, nonzero rho with rho^2=card(F), arbitrary nonzero auxiliary scale and arbitrary complex U,V. Signed power traces quantify over every natural n.
mathematics.general_identity: J(chi^p,phi^p)=J(chi,phi) by reindexing source-field Frobenius, without an order-seven hypothesis and without Frobenius on the complex target.
mathematics.full_packet: Product_(r=1..6)(U+J_r*V)=R_p(U,V)^f; all polynomial cross terms retained and f=1,3,6,3,6,2.
mathematics.power_traces: Sum_(r=1..6)(-J_r)^n=f*sum_(orbit representatives)(-J_r)^n for every natural n.
mathematics.actual_source_consumer: P_native(U,rho*V/u^15)=R_p(U,V)^f at t=u^7,X=Y=u^(-2). All principal compensation and both complete coherent periods are inherited from the proved source-to-Jacobi identification.
mathematics.vanishing_branch: For any finite field with q%7 not equal to 1, seventh powering is bijective and the actual affine curve z^7=x(1-x) has exactly q points, with no multiplicative-character assumption.
mathematics.small_characteristics: Characteristic two uses the Kummer model. Characteristic seven is covered only by the nonsplit affine count, and is excluded from the tame source and smooth genus-three interpretation.
mathematics.field_distinction: The fth-power factorization is over a field supporting order-seven characters. It is not a rational-prime Euler descent theorem.
mathematics.normalization_cost: Physical u=q^(-1/14),rho=sqrt(q) still costs q^(15/14) for trace extraction and q^(11/7) for the raw polynomial variable.
